question: g1_delete_item
answer:
Fixed. The bug: `deleteFromCart` was building `DELETE /cart/{cartID}/product/{item.id}`, but the backend endpoint `DELETE /cart/{code}/product/{sku}` matches cart line items by the product's **SKU string**, not its numeric database id. Since `item.id` never matched any line's `getSku()`, the facade deleted nothing (and returned a success-ish response), so the UI appeared to do nothing.

The one-line fix in [cartActions.js](~/code/benchmark/okf-local/main/source/work/g1_delete_item/source/codex/1/src/redux/actions/cartActions.js:163) swaps `item.id` for `item.sku` in the URL — the same field `addToCart` already uses for the product parameter, and present on the cart item objects returned by the API.

Files I used:
- Frontend (workspace): `src/redux/actions/cartActions.js` (edited), `src/util/constant.js` (endpoint prefixes), `src/pages/other/Cart.js` (how the item object is passed)
- Backend (pr2, read-only): `BasketEndpoint.java` (route + `sku` path param), `ShoppingCartFacadeImpl.java` (`removeShoppingCartItem` matching by `getSku()`), `Product.java` (confirms `id` vs `sku` fields)
